# MedAssist Compliance Pack

## Data Protection
Patient identifiers and names are redacted before any text reaches a model.

## Hosting
All inference is hosted in EU regions (Ireland).

## Human Oversight
Every triage summary is reviewed and approved by a clinician before release.

## Content Safety
Hate speech and harmful content is filtered and blocked by a moderation step.

## Transparency
All generated summaries are marked as AI-generated using C2PA content credentials and response headers.

## Provider Agreement
Our DPA with the model provider includes a zero data retention (ZDR) clause; prompts are never used for training.

## Training Data & Copyright
We follow the EU copyright policy for text and data mining (TDM) and honour opt-out reservations; training data provenance is documented.

## Technical Documentation
Annex IV technical documentation is maintained and versioned.

## DPIA
A Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) was completed and is reviewed annually.
